steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: The Desk page loads cleanly with all collapsible sections ready. Each section starts collapsed—expand them to view content.
steps.point_out: The 'Desk' heading and collapsed section headers are visible, zero console errors.

steps.title: Expand Microscope Readiness—shows testid retained in all states
steps.narration: Microscope Readiness expands showing 2 tick shards (symbol PG, session 2026-06-09) and corpus totals. This panel's DOM identifier is now retained whether loading, unavailable, or fully loaded.
steps.point_out: Shows 'Distinct symbol-days: 1', 'Distinct datasets: 2', and 2 PG rows in Legacy Tick Shards.

steps.title: Expand Scout Ledger—shows defensive degradation
steps.narration: Scout Ledger expands showing 'No candidates ledgered'—the honest empty state. The table now degrades gracefully: if any row were malformed, only that cell renders a placeholder instead of blanking the entire page.
steps.point_out: Shows 'No candidates ledgered' and 'No scout runs recorded yet', and the 'Run Screen' button is visible but not clicked.

steps.title: Expand Walk-Forward section—unaffected regression check
steps.narration: Walk-Forward expands showing no fold specs registered. This section is unaffected by this round's work, confirming changes stayed isolated.
steps.point_out: Shows 'No fold specs registered' and 'No walk-forward sequences run'.

steps.title: Expand Validation Vault—read-only state unchanged
steps.narration: Validation Vault expands showing no shards recorded and no universes registered. This section is read-only by design, and this round did not alter it.
steps.point_out: Shows 'No shards recorded' and 'No universes registered'—the correct read-only empty state.

steps.title: Expand Referee Registry—all sections load cleanly
steps.narration: Referee Registry (plus Referee Adjudications and Referee Runs) expand without errors, showing real content. All Desk sections remain stable and unaffected.
steps.point_out: Referee Registry expands with content and zero console errors, confirming the entire Desk page is resilient.

steps.title: Navigate to Structure page
steps.narration: The Structure page loads without error. This page is unaffected by this round's work—included to confirm changes stayed isolated.
steps.point_out: Structure page loads with Symbol and As-of date input fields ready.

steps.title: Enter AAPL and load Tradable Map
steps.narration: Entering AAPL and the as-of date (2026-06-22 16:00:00 ET), then clicking Load, renders the Tradable Map with exactly 10 bands. This confirms the Structure page's data pipeline is unaffected and stable.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map displays 10 band rows (5 resistance, 5 support), with the first resistance at 300.11–302.2 marked round-number.

steps.title: Fill as-of date and load
steps.narration: The as-of date field accepts the timestamp. Once submitted, the Tradable Map data loads immediately.

steps.title: Click Load to render Tradable Map
steps.narration: The Load button fetches and displays all 10 Tradable Map bands immediately, confirming the load logic is unaffected.
steps.point_out: Tradable Map renders 10 rows, comparison dropdown is present, no error.

steps.title: Watch Cockpit live tape update
steps.narration: The Cockpit page shows the live tape updating for SIM-BUYER in Simulated mode. Chart and tape are unaffected, confirming the round's backend and Desk changes stayed isolated.
steps.point_out: Live tape shows 'Buyer Control' with confidence and bid/ask updating between reads, confirming genuine live updates.
